description: The reach an institution chooses for each of its posts and calendar events (owner, 2026-11-10 for posts, 2026-11-13 for events; docs/wiki/profiles-and-access.md): the entity types whose posts carry a reach - an institution only, never an association, a list or a personal post - the three publics, and the typed 400 `code`s social-service refuses a reach with (apps/social-service/src/spaces/institution-reach.ts). The composers offer the reach picker on exactly these types (frontend/src/lib/posts/institutionReach.ts). Each side's spec asserts its constants equal these, so the two cannot drift apart.
